Features

  • Extra Attack

    Can make an additional attack after an unarmed or weapon attack.

  • Great Weapon Fighting

    When rolling two-handed melee damage, any die rolling 1 or 2 is rerolled once.

  • Opportunity Attack

    Attack an enemy moving out of reach.

  • Phalanx Formation

    Advantage on attack rolls within 3 m / 10 ft of an ally with a shield who isn't incapacitated.

  • Riposte

    Upon being missed with a melee attack, can expend a Superiority Die to retaliate.

Fist Attackers are summonable allies during Confront the Elder Brain, using their halberds and formation tactics to protect the city against the Absolutist forces' incursion.
“
For Baldur's Gate!
„
— Fist Attacker's battle cry

Involvement

Act Three

These Fist Attackers can be summoned with the  Gather Your Allies variant,  Florrick's Cohort if Florrick has been rescued during Free Counsellor Florrick. Summons a female gold dwarf, a female human, and a male gold dwarf (a Fist Defender) to fight at the party's side.
